```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5)

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)
library(data.table)

# Helper functions (Shannon equitability, parse_mutations, plotting, etc.)
source(params$fns_script)

GENE           <- params$gene
AA_LENGTH      <- as.integer(params$gene_length_aa)

# Stop codon position thresholds (first/last 15% of protein)
EARLY_STOP_LOCUS <- floor(AA_LENGTH * 0.15)
LATE_STOP_LOCUS  <- floor(AA_LENGTH * 0.85)
```

```{r load-data}
vardict <- fread(params$vardict_file) %>% as_tibble()
mutspace <- read.csv(params$mutspace_file) %>%
  fix_mutspace()  # normalise column names, recount num_possible_mutations

# Load gene segment boundaries (nucleotide positions → convert to AA)
seg_table <- read.csv(params$gene_segments_csv)
seg_row   <- seg_table[tolower(seg_table$target) == tolower(GENE), ]

seg_breaks_nt <- c(
  seg_row$Seg1Start,
  if (!is.na(seg_row$Seg2Start)) seg_row$Seg2Start else NULL,
  if (!is.na(seg_row$Seg3Start)) seg_row$Seg3Start else NULL
)
seg_breaks_aa <- unique(ceiling(seg_breaks_nt / 3))
```

## 1  Library overview

```{r overview-table}
n_barcodes    <- nrow(vardict)
n_bc_vcs2     <- sum(vardict$variant_call_support >= 2)
n_bc_vcs3     <- sum(vardict$variant_call_support >= 3)
mean_vcs      <- round(mean(vardict$variant_call_support), 2)
median_vcs    <- median(vardict$variant_call_support)
pct_singleton <- round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_call_support == 1), 2)

overview <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Total unique barcodes",
             "Barcodes with ≥2 supporting reads",
             "Barcodes with ≥3 supporting reads",
             "Mean reads per barcode",
             "Median reads per barcode",
             "% singletons"),
  Value  = c(n_barcodes, n_bc_vcs2, n_bc_vcs3,
             mean_vcs, median_vcs, pct_singleton)
)
knitr::kable(overview, caption = paste(GENE, "— library overview"))
```

## 2  Supporting reads per barcode

```{r vcs-dist, fig.height=4}
vcs_capped <- pmin(vardict$variant_call_support, 50)

ggplot(data.frame(vcs = vcs_capped), aes(x = vcs)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50),
                     labels = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, "≥50")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = comma) +
  labs(title = paste(GENE, "— CCS reads per barcode"),
       x = "Reads per barcode (capped at 50)", y = "Number of barcodes") +
  theme_classic()
```

## 3  Variant type proportions

```{r classify-variants}
# Extract the AA position from a stop codon string like "P45*"
stop_position <- function(mutations) {
  as.integer(str_extract(mutations, "\\d+(?=\\*)"))
}

classify_variant <- function(mutations, n_aa_subs, n_indels) {
  case_when(

    # ── wildtype ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    mutations == "wt"                                         ~ "wildtype",

    # ── synonymous (codon change(s) but no AA change and no indel) ────────────
    n_aa_subs == 0 & n_indels == 0                           ~ "synonymous",

    # ── complex: mixture of AA substitution(s) AND indel(s) ──────────────────
    # n_aa_substitutions counts only CODON-level substitutions, so this
    # correctly catches variants like "P13R 8fs" but NOT codon-disrupting
    # indels (which carry their AA-level change inside the indel annotation).
    n_aa_subs > 0 & n_indels > 0                            ~ "complex",

    # ── pure indels (no separate codon substitutions) ─────────────────────────
    # Frameshift: indel length NOT a multiple of 3
    n_indels > 0 & grepl("fs", mutations)                   ~ "frameshift",

    # Codon-disrupting in-frame indel: length IS multiple of 3 but starts
    # mid-codon, altering flanking AAs; annotated with "delins" in HGVS style.
    n_indels > 0 & grepl("delins", mutations)               ~ "codon-disrupting indel",

    # Clean in-frame deletion: whole codon(s) removed, no flanking AA change.
    # Pattern: {AA}{pos}del  or  {AA}{pos}_{AA}{pos}del
    n_indels > 0 & grepl("del", mutations)                  ~ "clean in-frame deletion",

    # Clean in-frame insertion: whole codon(s) added between two existing codons.
    # Pattern: {AA}{pos}_{AA}{pos}ins{AAs}  or  0_{AA}1ins{AAs}
    n_indels > 0 & grepl("ins", mutations)                  ~ "clean in-frame insertion",

    # Catch-all for indels (shouldn't occur with current parse_indel logic)
    n_indels > 0                                            ~ "other indel",

    # ── pure AA substitutions (no indels) ─────────────────────────────────────
    # Stop codons (>=1 nonsyn sub that introduces a stop), split by position.
    # Thresholds: EARLY_STOP_LOCUS = floor(AA_LENGTH * 0.15),
    #             LATE_STOP_LOCUS  = floor(AA_LENGTH * 0.85)
    n_aa_subs >= 1 & grepl("\\*", mutations) &
      stop_position(mutations) <  EARLY_STOP_LOCUS          ~ "early stop",
    n_aa_subs >= 1 & grepl("\\*", mutations) &
      stop_position(mutations) >= LATE_STOP_LOCUS           ~ "late stop",
    n_aa_subs >= 1 & grepl("\\*", mutations)               ~ "medium stop",

    # Single or multiple nonsynonymous substitutions
    n_aa_subs == 1                                          ~ "single missense",
    n_aa_subs  > 1                                          ~ "multi missense",

    # Unexpected (should not occur)
    TRUE                                                    ~ "other"
  )
}

vardict <- vardict %>%
  mutate(variant_type = classify_variant(
    mutations, n_aa_substitutions, number_of_indels))

type_order <- c("wildtype", "synonymous",
                "single missense", "multi missense",
                "early stop", "medium stop", "late stop",
                "frameshift",
                "codon-disrupting indel",
                "clean in-frame deletion", "clean in-frame insertion",
                "complex", "other indel", "other")
vardict$variant_type <- factor(vardict$variant_type, levels = type_order)

# Named color palette — consistent across datasets regardless of which
# categories are present. Colors grouped semantically:
#   grey tones  = neutral (wt, synonymous)
#   blues       = missense substitutions
#   red/orange  = stop codons
#   purples     = frameshifts / codon-disrupting indels
#   greens      = clean in-frame indels
#   brown/grey  = complex / other
TYPE_COLORS <- c(
  "wildtype"                 = "#AAAAAA",
  "synonymous"               = "#DDDDDD",
  "single missense"          = "#56B4E9",
  "multi missense"           = "#0072B2",
  "early stop"               = "#D55E00",
  "medium stop"              = "#E69F00",
  "late stop"                = "#F5C842",
  "frameshift"               = "#CC79A7",
  "codon-disrupting indel"   = "#9B59B6",
  "clean in-frame deletion"  = "#009E73",
  "clean in-frame insertion" = "#66C2A5",
  "complex"                  = "#8B4513",
  "other indel"              = "#C0C0C0",
  "other"                    = "#708090"
)
```

```{r type-bar, fig.height=5}
type_summary <- vardict %>%
  count(variant_type) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n),
         pct_label  = paste0(round(100 * proportion, 1), "%"))

ggplot(type_summary, aes(x = variant_type, y = proportion, fill = variant_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = pct_label), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = TYPE_COLORS) +
  labs(title = paste(GENE, "— variant type proportions"),
       x = NULL, y = "Proportion of barcodes") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```

```{r type-table}
knitr::kable(type_summary %>% select(variant_type, n, proportion) %>%
               mutate(proportion = round(proportion, 4)),
             caption = "Barcode counts by variant type")
```

## 4  Mutational coverage and saturation

```{r mut-by-locus}
# Use only single-missense barcodes for saturation analysis
missense <- vardict %>%
  filter(variant_type == "single missense")

# Build targets manifest for parse_mutations()
# We need the vardict in global env with the expected name
df_name <- paste0(GENE, ".vardict")
assign(df_name, missense %>% rename(aa_mutations = mutations))
mutspace_name <- paste0(GENE, "_mutspace")
assign(mutspace_name, mutspace)

targets_manifest <- data.frame(
  dataframe = df_name,
  Length    = AA_LENGTH * 3,   # parse_mutations divides by 3 internally
  mutspace  = mutspace_name
)

mutbylocus_list <- parse_mutations(1, targets_manifest)
mutbylocus <- mutbylocus_list[[1]]
mutbylocus  <- add_gene_segment(mutbylocus, seg_breaks_aa)
```

```{r saturation-plot, fig.height=6}
mutbylocus_plot <- mutbylocus %>%
  mutate(MutSat = (mutation_count_unique_aa / num_possible_mutations) * 100)

pct_loci_covered  <- round(100 * mean(mutbylocus$mutation_count_aa > 0), 1)
pct_loci_sat80    <- round(100 * mean(mutbylocus_plot$MutSat >= 80, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
mean_shannon_E    <- round(mean(mutbylocus$E, na.rm = TRUE), 3)

p_sat <- ggplot(mutbylocus_plot, aes(x = locus, y = MutSat, color = GeneSegment)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(80, 100), color = "lightgrey") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, min(150, max(mutbylocus_plot$MutSat, na.rm=TRUE) * 1.1))) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(title = paste(GENE, "— mutational space saturation"),
       x = "Amino acid position", y = "Saturation (%)",
       color = "Segment") +
  theme_classic()

p_count <- ggplot(mutbylocus, aes(x = locus, y = mutation_count_aa, color = GeneSegment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(title = paste(GENE, "— total AA mutations per locus"),
       x = "Amino acid position", y = "Mutation count (log scale)",
       color = "Segment") +
  theme_classic()

ggarrange(p_count, p_sat, nrow = 2, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
```

```{r saturation-by-segment, fig.height=4}
ggplot(mutbylocus_plot, aes(x = GeneSegment, y = MutSat)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, min(150, max(mutbylocus_plot$MutSat, na.rm=TRUE)*1.1))) +
  labs(title = paste(GENE, "— saturation by gene segment"),
       x = "Segment", y = "Saturation (%)") +
  theme_classic()
```

```

```{r shannon-by-segment, fig.height=4}

```

## 6  Library representation (over/under-abundant barcodes)

```{r representation, fig.height=4}
# Lorenz-style cumulative fraction of reads vs barcodes
vardict_sorted <- vardict %>%
  arrange(variant_call_support) %>%
  mutate(cum_frac_barcodes = row_number() / n(),
         cum_frac_reads    = cumsum(variant_call_support) / sum(variant_call_support))

p_lorenz <- ggplot(vardict_sorted, aes(x = cum_frac_barcodes, y = cum_frac_reads)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  labs(title = paste(GENE, "— barcode representation (Lorenz curve)"),
       x = "Cumulative fraction of barcodes (ranked by read count)",
       y = "Cumulative fraction of reads") +
  theme_classic()
print(p_lorenz)

# Gini coefficient
n <- nrow(vardict_sorted)
gini_coef <- round(1 - 2 * sum(vardict_sorted$cum_frac_reads * (1/n)), 4)
```

Top 10 most-abundant barcodes (potential outliers):

```{r top-barcodes}
knitr::kable(
  vardict %>%
    arrange(desc(variant_call_support)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    select(barcode, variant_call_support, mutations, variant_type),
  caption = "Top 10 barcodes by read support"
)
```

Gini coefficient of barcode abundance distribution: **`r gini_coef`**
(0 = perfectly even; 1 = maximally skewed)

## 7  Summary statistics

```{r write-summary}
n_loci <- nrow(mutbylocus)

summary_df <- data.frame(
  gene                    = GENE,
  gene_length_aa          = AA_LENGTH,
  n_barcodes_total        = n_barcodes,
  n_barcodes_vcs2         = n_bc_vcs2,
  n_barcodes_vcs3         = n_bc_vcs3,
  mean_vcs                = mean_vcs,
  median_vcs              = median_vcs,
  pct_singleton           = pct_singleton,
  pct_wildtype            = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "wildtype"), 2),
  pct_synonymous          = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "synonymous"), 2),
  pct_single_missense     = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "single missense"), 2),
  pct_multi_missense      = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "multi missense"), 2),
  pct_early_stop          = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "early stop"), 2),
  pct_medium_stop         = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "medium stop"), 2),
  pct_late_stop           = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "late stop"), 2),
  pct_frameshift          = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "frameshift"), 2),
  pct_codon_disrupting    = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "codon-disrupting indel"), 2),
  pct_clean_inframe_indel = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type %in%
                                    c("clean in-frame deletion","clean in-frame insertion")), 2),
  pct_complex             = round(100 * mean(vardict$variant_type == "complex"), 2),
  pct_loci_any_mutation   = pct_loci_covered,
  pct_loci_sat80          = pct_loci_sat80,
  mean_shannon_E          = mean_shannon_E,
  gini_coefficient        = gini_coef
)

write.csv(summary_df, params$summary_outfile, row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(t(summary_df), col.names = "Value", caption = "Summary statistics")
```
